integrity: Full proof and independently executable small-case arithmetic checker included. No external independent review or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The formula concerns commuting pairs with one idempotent in the inverse monoid of restrictions of a free finite-group action; it does not count all commuting pairs, does not extend unchanged to nonfree actions, and distinguishes only group element-order multiplicities. A relevant full centralizer paper was not accessible for comprehensive priority assessment.
title: Mixed commuting-rank polynomials recover group element-order spectra
